charge_port.notes: mbusa lists J1772 (AC) and Combined Charging System (DC).

supercharger_access.notes: mbusa NACS page: EQB, EQE, EQS and G 580 with a CCS1 inlet use the Mercedes-approved NACS-to-CCS1 adapter (included from MY26, otherwise sold by dealers). Canada: no Mercedes-Benz Canada page found; the same adapter route is assumed for the CA edition of this car.

wheels.notes: EQS 450+ SUV. Carried from the 2023 EQS 450 4MATIC SUV page (20 in); 2024 SUVs moved to 21 in, no page for this exact year opened.
